title: Blood Drive
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office hosts a blood drive where Michael nervously participates and passes out. Meanwhile, Michael attempts to organize a singles mixer, and the office engages in humorous conversations about relationships and love. Michael also discusses his past relationship with Holly and considers getting back into dating, while other characters share their own stories and experiences.
